guide.title: WireGuard guide
guide.intro: WireGuard creates a private tunnel between your tower and your laptop. Here are the steps, using 10.0.0.1 for the tower and 10.0.0.2 for the laptop.
guide.step2: Create the WireGuard tunnel: for example 10.0.0.1 for the tower and 10.0.0.2 for the laptop, then bring it up on both sides.
guide.step3: On the tower: Lucania › Connect machines › Remote access, in Advanced options pick the WireGuard interface, turn on server mode, then copy the code shown.
guide.step3Firewall: Windows asks to allow Lucania through the firewall: accept for private networks, or create inbound TCP 4750 and UDP 4751 (automatic search) rules limited to the chosen network.
guide.step4: On the laptop: paste the tower code. Automatic search rarely crosses WireGuard: in Advanced options, enter the address http://10.0.0.1:4750, then “Connect with this address”.
guide.step5: This PC keeps its own engine and models: the header dot follows the local engine. The tower's models are added to the chat model picker, marked with a server icon. Shutting the tower down is set up in Connect machines › Shutdown.
guide.security: Security: the connection uses plain HTTP, with no encryption of its own. Use it ONLY inside the WireGuard tunnel; the key only travels through that tunnel.
guide.docs: Full guide: docs/wireguard.md in the repository.
